body:
## Outcome

Make accessibility and internationalization acceptance requirements explicit for every component and pattern.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M1: Foundations and architecture · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Define the applicable current WCAG AA web baseline and native VoiceOver/TalkBack expectations, including contrast, focus, keyboard order, labels, touch targets, and live announcements.
- Specify native accessibility roles/states, screen-reader navigation, Dynamic Type, RTL/logical layout, locale fonts, text expansion, number/date formatting, and reduced motion.
- Define keyboard shortcuts and pointer/hover alternatives, iOS/Android back/dismissal, safe area behavior, focus restoration, and no-feedback fallbacks.
- Create a component acceptance checklist and accessibility exception process with owners and expiry; distinguish automated results from physical/device observations.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A versioned baseline and component checklist are available to implementers, covering both DOM and RN semantics.
- [ ] Reference flows can be completed with keyboard only, VoiceOver, TalkBack, large text, RTL, and sound/haptics disabled.
- [ ] All critical status and success/error information is available visually and through appropriate accessible semantics.
- [ ] Unsupported hardware capabilities and unperformed device checks are documented accurately rather than treated as passing tests.

## Prerequisites

- #8 — Define spacing, geometry, density, and adaptive layout rules

## References

- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)
- [Hapticplatforms](https://github.com/bloxwap/haptic/blob/main/apps/docs/content/docs/platforms.mdx)
- [Font](https://github.com/bloxwap/font/tree/main/apps/docs)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Establish accessibility, localization, and platform behavior standards
